read_flow_middlebury: read a .flo optical flow file in Middlebury format and return a numpy array
read_pfm_file: read a PFM file and return the image data as a numpy array with proper endianness
read_disparity_sintel_stereo: read a Sintel Stereo disparity PNG file and return disparity values with a validity mask
read_disparity_middlebury: read a Middlebury ground truth disparity PFM file and return disparity with non-occlusion mask
read_generic_file: read image, flow, or PFM files by extension and return the appropriate numpy array or PIL Image
